# Go AST Differ

This tool analyzes and compares Go code between two Git commits at the AST level, providing detailed information about changes to functions, types, interfaces, and methods.

## Building

```bash
go build -o cada ./go-ast-differ
```

## Usage

```bash
./cada <repoUrl> <localRepoPath> <branchName> <currentCommit> [outputPath]
```

Example:
```bash
./cada https://github.com/username/repo.git ./repo-clone main abc123def456 ./output
```

## Output Files

- `all_code_changes.json`: Complete breakdown of all changes
- `function_changes.json`: Changes to functions only
- `type_changes.json`: Changes to type declarations only
- `interface_changes.json`: Changes to interfaces only
- `method_changes.json`: Changes to methods only
- `function_changes_granular.json`: Detailed analysis of function call changes between versions

## Modules

- `main.go`: Main application entry point
- `types.go`: Data structure definitions
- `gitops.go`: Git-related operations
- `astparse.go`: AST parsing utilities
- `differ.go`: AST comparison logic
- `output.go`: Output generation functionality
- `granular.go`: Granular function change analysis
